title: KV cache and speculative decoding

paper.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement KV cache and speculative decoding: implement cached autoregressive decoding and rejection-corrected speculative sampling; audit exactness and tokens per second. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use decode-fixture; required output: Prompt and cache -> next-token distribution plus new cache. Evaluate distribution_max_error (minimize). Position offsets correct; speculative rejection correction preserves target distribution. Required ablation: Compare uncached cached and speculative paths on identical prompts. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
